## Analysis
sol_0038 confirms sol_0036 is a strict local optimum under single toggles and ordinary 1-for-1 swaps in `[0,170]`; more pointwise VNS is unlikely to help. The regression at n=59 further rejects deletion-driven shrinking. Progress from sol_0035 to sol_0036 instead suggests coordinated changes to the dense core and asymmetric fringes matter, with beneficial moves crossing score valleys. Search should preserve the 66-point scale while replacing contiguous fringe blocks, rather than perturbing isolated coordinates. The incumbent’s span 158 also leaves little evidence that extending the coordinate domain is useful.

## Next
